Before you play

Flashing lights and screen shake

This game has flashing colors, strobing police lights, color cycling, glitch effects and heavy camera shake. A small number of people can have seizures from flashing lights or patterns, even with no history of epilepsy. If you or anyone in your family has had seizures, talk to a doctor before you play. Stop at once if you feel dizzy or disoriented, or notice blurred vision or twitching.

You can change this any time in Settings, under Comfort.
